limitations: A storage-GRANTED durable round-trip across a SERVICE-WORKER restart is NOT exercised by the integration harness: the optional storage permission requires a headed owner gesture (chrome.permissions.request) that a headless profile cannot grant. The durable WRITE path itself is unit-tested (kvSet returns 'durable' when the backend is present + healthy, and throws StorageBackendError when the backend write fails).

The error durability state is exercised by calling the production pure renderer (lib/durability-ui.js) directly on the real element — there is deliberately no shipped fault global/route to force a backend write failure in the browser (the reviewer's no-shipped-fault-seam requirement). The backend-failure REJECT path is unit-tested at the KV level.
